description: Structural diff of two Arc diagrams. Returns a DiagramDelta — added/removed/moved/changed nodes, connector adds/removes/changes (keyed by connector id or from→to), connectorStyles and groups deltas, layoutChanged. Feed it to <ArcDiagram data={head} delta={delta} /> for a diff render.

base.description: Base ArcDiagramData JSON object or JSON string

head.description: Head ArcDiagramData JSON object or JSON string
